resources.string: Choose the route explicitly. Direct mode sends the selected passage from your phone to a cloud provider, not an on-device model. No automatic route switching. Saving makes no network or billable request.
Use a model ID from your provider account. Availability and price are not verified by saving. Tokens are encrypted on this device and scoped to this BookOrbit account and server.
Direct Story Guide is not supported yet: structured context and spoiler boundaries are not verified. BookOrbit is not used as a fallback. Select the server route explicitly to use its Story Guide.
Configure the AI connection or reopen this panel after changing it. No fallback request was made.

Send only this selected passage to %1$s using model %2$s? The cloud provider may charge your account. No full book, BookOrbit token or account identifiers are sent. The AI can still be wrong or reveal inferred spoilers. No retry or route fallback is automatic.
